1	import '../../../../core/failure/failure.dart';
2	import '../../domain/entities/chat_message.dart';
3	import '../../domain/entities/chat_session.dart';
4	
5	/// `ChatCubit`'s own sealed state — AD-12: "Chat's state is its own sealed
6	/// class, never forced into `Resource<T>`", because it isn't a single
7	/// fetch (the append-only [ChatReady.messages] list keeps growing one
8	/// token at a time while a response streams in, long after the initial
9	/// bootstrap fetch that produced it has already resolved).
10	sealed class ChatState {
11	  const ChatState();
12	}
13	
14	/// The initial state, and the state while `ChatCubit.init()`'s own
15	/// session-bootstrap (list-or-create-one-session) + history fetch are
16	/// still in flight.
17	class ChatBootstrapLoading extends ChatState {
18	  const ChatBootstrapLoading();
19	}
20	
21	/// I/O matrix: "Bootstrap failure" — `chat-sessions-list`/`create` (or the
22	/// history fetch right after) failed; the screen shows this generic error
23	/// state instead of spinning forever.
24	class ChatBootstrapError extends ChatState {
25	  const ChatBootstrapError(this.failure);
26	
27	  final Failure failure;
28	
29	  @override
30	  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
31	      identical(this, other) ||
32	      (other is ChatBootstrapError && other.failure == failure);
33	
34	  @override
35	  int get hashCode => failure.hashCode;
36	}
37	
38	/// The composer is enabled, [messages] renders — [ChatUiMessage]'s own
39	/// [ChatUiMessage.status] drives each bubble's one of the 3 visible states
40	/// (streaming/failed/complete, RF04's Acceptance Criteria).
41	class ChatReady extends ChatState {
42	  const ChatReady({
43	    required this.sessionId,
44	    required this.messages,
45	    required this.sessions,
46	    this.isSending = false,
47	    this.restoreScrollOffset,
48	    this.isOffline = false,
49	  });
50	
51	  final String sessionId;
52	
53	  /// Append-only for the lifetime of this cubit (Code Map) — a message is
54	  /// ever only added to the end, or mutated in place by id (a streaming
55	  /// AI bubble's own `content`/`status`), never removed or reordered.
56	  final List<ChatUiMessage> messages;
57	
58	  /// Every Chat Session the drawer's own "CONVERSAS" section renders
59	  /// (spec-6-2 Code Map) — populated once by `ChatCubit._bootstrap`'s own
60	  /// `listSessions()`/`createSession()` call, then kept current by
61	  /// `ChatCubit.startNewSession` prepending its own result. Never
62	  /// re-fetched/paginated past that first page (Boundaries: "Never:
63	  /// paginating past the backend's default first page").
64	  final List<ChatSession> sessions;
65	
66	  /// Whether `ChatCubit.sendMessage`'s own send is actively in flight —
67	  /// the composer's one enable/disable signal (`_ChatComposer`). Kept as
68	  /// its own field rather than derived by scanning [messages] for a
69	  /// persisted `streaming` status: a message restored from history/cache
70	  /// can legitimately carry that status without a send being in flight
71	  /// (I/O matrix: mid-stream drop), which would otherwise permanently
72	  /// disable the composer.
73	  final bool isSending;
74	
75	  /// The scroll offset `ChatScreen` should jump to the moment this exact
76	  /// [ChatReady] becomes the active session (spec-6-2 I/O matrix: "Switch
77	  /// session") — `ChatCubit._scrollOffsets[sessionId]`'s own last
78	  /// recorded value, or `null` when none was ever recorded (a brand new
79	  /// session, or a session visited for the first time this app run),
80	  /// which `ChatScreen` reads as "jump to bottom instead" (Code Map).
81	  /// Deliberately never cleared by the cubit itself once set — `ChatScreen`
82	  /// only consults it the instant [sessionId] changes from the previous
83	  /// state it observed, so a later unrelated emit (e.g. a streamed token)
84	  /// carrying the same value forward via [copyWith] is harmless (Design
85	  /// Notes).
86	  final double? restoreScrollOffset;
87	
88	  /// spec-6-3 — whether the device currently has no connectivity
89	  /// (`ChatCubit`'s own `ConnectivityWatcher` subscription), `false` by
90	  /// default (bootstrap's own first guess, before any connectivity
91	  /// reading has ever arrived). Drives `_ChatComposer.canSend`, the
92	  /// offline banner between `_ChatHeader` and the message list, and
93	  /// `AppDrawer`'s "Novo Chat" gate — additive only (Boundaries): never
94	  /// changes `ChatRepositoryImpl`'s own existing reactive
95	  /// `Failure.networkOffline` handling.
96	  final bool isOffline;
97	
98	  ChatReady copyWith({
99	    List<ChatUiMessage>? messages,
100	    List<ChatSession>? sessions,
101	    bool? isSending,
102	    double? restoreScrollOffset,
103	    bool? isOffline,
104	  }) => ChatReady(
105	    sessionId: sessionId,
106	    messages: messages ?? this.messages,
107	    sessions: sessions ?? this.sessions,
108	    isSending: isSending ?? this.isSending,
109	    restoreScrollOffset: restoreScrollOffset ?? this.restoreScrollOffset,
110	    isOffline: isOffline ?? this.isOffline,
111	  );
112	}
113	
114	/// One bubble's own presentation-layer shape — distinct from the domain
115	/// `ChatMessage` entity (Code Map) because a message in flight has no
116	/// server-assigned `seq`/`retryCount`/`createdAt` yet; [id] is a locally
117	/// generated, UI-only identifier (`ChatCubit._nextLocalId()`), never the
118	/// server's own message id (Design Notes: `message_created`'s id is the
119	/// *user* message's server id, unused by this story — see
120	/// `ChatStreamEvent`'s own doc).
121	class ChatUiMessage {
122	  const ChatUiMessage({
123	    required this.id,
124	    required this.role,
125	    required this.content,
126	    required this.status,
127	    this.serverId,
128	    this.createdAt,
129	  });
130	
131	  final String id;
132	  final ChatMessageRole role;
133	  final String content;
134	  final ChatMessageStatus status;
135	
136	  /// The server-persisted `createdAt` (`ChatMessage.createdAt`), known from
137	  /// the moment this message is loaded from history/cache
138	  /// (`ChatCubit._fromDomain`). `null` for a message created locally
139	  /// mid-session (an optimistic user bubble, or the AI bubble a send/retry
140	  /// is about to stream into) — neither `message_created`, `token`, nor
141	  /// `done` ever carries a timestamp, so there's no server time to show for
142	  /// one until the next full history reload; `ChatBubble` reads `null` here
143	  /// as its own cue to show "agora" instead (`cerne-prototype.html`'s own
144	  /// `sendMessage`/`streamAiResponse` use that exact placeholder for a
145	  /// just-added message, never a computed clock time).
146	  final String? createdAt;
147	
148	  /// spec-6-3 Design Notes: "`serverId` (not reusing `id`) avoids ever
149	  /// swapping a `ChatUiMessage.id` mid-stream" — the backend-assigned id
150	  /// this message is persisted under, known from the moment it's loaded
151	  /// from history/cache (`ChatCubit._fromDomain`), or captured mid-session
152	  /// off the SSE `message_created` event once/if it arrives
153	  /// (`ChatCubit._applyStreamEvent`). `null` for a just-sent message whose
154	  /// stream hasn't delivered `message_created` yet (or ever, on a very
155	  /// early drop) — the one value [ChatCubit.retryMessage] reads off the
156	  /// user message preceding a `failed` AI bubble to decide whether it can
157	  /// call `chat-messages-retry` at all (Boundaries: "Never calling
158	  /// `chat-messages-retry` with no `serverId`").
159	  final String? serverId;
160	
161	  ChatUiMessage copyWith({
162	    String? content,
163	    ChatMessageStatus? status,
164	    String? serverId,
165	  }) => ChatUiMessage(
166	    id: id,
167	    role: role,
168	    content: content ?? this.content,
169	    status: status ?? this.status,
170	    serverId: serverId ?? this.serverId,
171	    createdAt: createdAt,
172	  );
173	
174	  @override
175	  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
176	      identical(this, other) ||
177	      (other is ChatUiMessage &&
178	          other.id == id &&
179	          other.role == role &&
180	          other.content == content &&
181	          other.status == status &&
182	          other.serverId == serverId &&
183	          other.createdAt == createdAt);
184	
185	  @override
186	  int get hashCode =>
187	      Object.hash(id, role, content, status, serverId, createdAt);
188	
189	  @override
190	  String toString() =>
191	      'ChatUiMessage(id: $id, role: $role, content: $content, '
192	      'status: $status, serverId: $serverId, createdAt: $createdAt)';
193	}

1	import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
2	
3	import '../../../../core/design_tokens.dart';
4	import '../../domain/entities/chat_message.dart';
5	import '../cubit/chat_state.dart';
6	
7	/// Review finding: shared by the `Semantics.label` and the visible `Text`
8	/// below so a future copy edit can't desync the spoken label from what's
9	/// actually on screen.
10	const _retryCopy = 'Falha ao gerar resposta — toque para tentar novamente';
11	
12	/// One message bubble — user (Boundaries: `colorChatBubbleUser`, squared
13	/// bottom-right corner) vs AI (`colorSurfaceElevated`, squared bottom-left
14	/// corner, resting [DesignTokens.elevation1]). Exactly the 3 visible
15	/// states RF04's Acceptance Criteria names render here, driven by
16	/// [ChatUiMessage.status]: `streaming` (progressive text + blinking
17	/// cursor), `failed` (spec-6-3: a tappable tap-to-retry indicator,
18	/// invoking [onRetry], renders *above* the timestamp caption —
19	/// `cerne-prototype.html`'s own markup never hides the time behind it),
20	/// `complete` (plain text, nothing else). [ChatUiMessage.content] itself is
21	/// rendered as-is in every state — never cleared on failure (I/O matrix).
22	class ChatBubble extends StatefulWidget {
23	  const ChatBubble({required this.message, this.onRetry, super.key});
24	
25	  final ChatUiMessage message;
26	
27	  /// spec-6-3 — invoked when the user taps a `failed` AI bubble's own
28	  /// retry copy; `null` on a user bubble (never shown there, only an AI
29	  /// response ever fails) or whenever a caller has nothing to wire it to.
30	  final VoidCallback? onRetry;
31	
32	  @override
33	  State<ChatBubble> createState() => _ChatBubbleState();
34	}
35	
36	class _ChatBubbleState extends State<ChatBubble>
37	    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
38	  late final AnimationController _cursorController;
39	
40	  @override
41	  void initState() {
42	    super.initState();
43	    _cursorController = AnimationController(
44	      vsync: this,
45	      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 600),
46	    );
47	    _syncCursorAnimation();
48	  }
49	
50	  @override
51	  void didUpdateWidget(ChatBubble oldWidget) {
52	    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
53	    _syncCursorAnimation();
54	  }
55	
56	  /// Keeps the ticker running only while actually needed — a message
57	  /// that finalizes to `complete`/`failed` must stop ticking forever
58	  /// after, both so a long-lived chat session never leaks one live
59	  /// `AnimationController` per past message, and so nothing waiting on
60	  /// "every animation in the tree has settled" (e.g. a test's own
61	  /// `pumpAndSettle()`) ever blocks on a bubble that finished streaming.
62	  void _syncCursorAnimation() {
63	    final shouldAnimate = widget.message.status == ChatMessageStatus.streaming;
64	    if (shouldAnimate && !_cursorController.isAnimating) {
65	      _cursorController.repeat(reverse: true);
66	    } else if (!shouldAnimate && _cursorController.isAnimating) {
67	      _cursorController.stop();
68	    }
69	  }
70	
71	  @override
72	  void dispose() {
73	    _cursorController.dispose();
74	    super.dispose();
75	  }
76	
77	  @override
78	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
79	    final message = widget.message;
80	    final onRetry = widget.onRetry;
81	    final isUser = message.role == ChatMessageRole.user;
82	    // Boundaries: "cursor skipped under
83	    // `MediaQuery.of(context).disableAnimations`" — the real token text
84	    // itself always reveals as real tokens actually arrive (there is no
85	    // separate typing-speed animation to collapse here), only the
86	    // blinking-cursor glyph is conditional on Reduce Motion.
87	    final reduceMotion = MediaQuery.of(context).disableAnimations;
88	    final showCursor =
89	        message.status == ChatMessageStatus.streaming && !reduceMotion;
90	
91	    // spec-6-3 Boundaries: tap-to-retry copy, tappable, 44pt min tap
92	    // target — replaces the earlier generic (non-tappable) error
93	    // indicator. Correction: `cerne-prototype.html`'s own markup renders
94	    // this as a bare `<span>` below the bubble — plain red text, no
95	    // background band, not banded *inside* the bubble the way a previous
96	    // pass built it. Correction: the prototype's own `{{ msg.time }}` span
97	    // sits right after this one, unconditionally — this note is additional
98	    // (shown above the timestamp), never a replacement for it; an earlier
99	    // pass rendered the two as mutually exclusive, hiding the time whenever
100	    // a bubble failed.
101	    // `Semantics(button: true)` only wraps it when [onRetry] is actually
102	    // supplied (review finding) — a bubble built with no retry callback
103	    // must never be announced to a screen reader as a working button.
104	    final retryIndicator = InkWell(
105	      onTap: onRetry,
106	      child: ConstrainedBox(
107	        constraints: const BoxConstraints(
108	          minHeight: DesignTokens.insertionModalTapTargetMin,
109	        ),
110	        child: Align(
111	          alignment: isUser ? Alignment.centerRight : Alignment.centerLeft,
112	          child: Padding(
113	            padding: DesignTokens.chatFailureIndicatorPadding,
114	            child: Text(
115	              _retryCopy,
116	              style: DesignTokens.textCaptionSm.copyWith(
117	                color: DesignTokens.colorError,
118	              ),
119	            ),
120	          ),
121	        ),
122	      ),
123	    );
124	    final retryIndicatorWithSemantics = onRetry == null
125	        ? retryIndicator
126	        : Semantics(
127	            button: true,
128	            label: _retryCopy,
129	            excludeSemantics: true,
130	            child: retryIndicator,
131	          );
132	
133	    // Correction: `cerne-prototype.html`'s own bubble markup puts this
134	    // `IBM Plex Mono`/`colorTextSecondary` caption *below* the bubble, on
135	    // every message — including a `failed` one (right below the retry
136	    // note, never hidden behind it) — a previous pass never rendered it at
137	    // all. "agora"
138	    // ([ChatUiMessage.createdAt]'s own doc) for a message with no server
139	    // timestamp yet; otherwise the server `createdAt`'s local wall-clock
140	    // time, `HH:mm` (same parse-for-display convention

172	                      : DesignTokens.colorSurfaceElevated,

174	                    topLeft: const Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusMd),
175	                    topRight: const Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusMd),
176	                    bottomLeft: Radius.circular(
177	                      isUser ? DesignTokens.radiusMd : 0,
178	                    ),
179	                    bottomRight: Radius.circular(
180	                      isUser ? 0 : DesignTokens.radiusMd,

182	                  ),

184	                ),

209	              // *and* the time caption right below it (the retry
210	              // indicator's own `chatFailureIndicatorPadding` bottom inset
211	              // already supplies the matching 4px gap between the two).
212	              if (message.status == ChatMessageStatus.failed)
213	                retryIndicatorWithSemantics,

223	/// [ChatBubble]'s own timestamp caption — `createdAt`'s local wall-clock
224	/// time, `HH:mm`, or "agora" for a message with no server timestamp yet
225	/// ([ChatUiMessage.createdAt]'s own doc) or one that fails to parse
226	/// (RNF09: never throws on a malformed value), same defensive shape
227	/// `entry_record_card.dart`'s own `_formatTime` already uses.
228	String _formatTime(String? createdAt) {
229	  if (createdAt == null) {
230	    return 'agora';
231	  }
232	  final local = DateTime.tryParse(createdAt)?.toLocal();
233	  if (local == null) {
234	    return 'agora';
235	  }
236	  final hour = local.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
237	  final minute = local.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
238	  return '$hour:$minute';
239	}

16	/// Tela 1 — Home/Chat, RF04's first real (non-placeholder) screen: the
17	/// same dark-green header + drawer chrome the deleted
18	/// `HomeChatPlaceholderScreen` used, now with a real message list and
19	/// composer. [cubit] is injected rather than resolved internally
20	/// (`sl<ChatCubit>()` stays the router's own job, Code Map), so a test can
21	/// pass a fake-repository-backed instance directly.
22	class ChatScreen extends StatefulWidget {
23	  const ChatScreen({required this.cubit, super.key});
24	
25	  final ChatCubit cubit;
26	
27	  @override
28	  State<ChatScreen> createState() => _ChatScreenState();
29	}
30	
31	class _ChatScreenState extends State<ChatScreen> {
32	  final _textController = TextEditingController();
33	  final _scrollController = ScrollController();
34	  final _composerFocusNode = FocusNode();
35	
36	  /// The last [ChatReady.sessionId] this screen has already reacted to —
37	  /// `null` until the very first [ChatReady] (bootstrap). Distinguishes
38	  /// "the active session just changed" (spec-6-2: `switchSession`/
39	  /// `startNewSession`, or the initial bootstrap) from an ordinary
40	  /// in-session update (a streamed token, a bookmark state change) that
41	  /// happens to carry the same [ChatReady.restoreScrollOffset] value
42	  /// forward via `copyWith` — only the former should ever trigger a
43	  /// scroll jump or request composer focus.
44	  String? _lastSessionId;
45	
46	  @override
47	  void initState() {
48	    super.initState();
49	    // `ChatCubit.init()`'s own no-op guard makes this safe to call on
50	    // every mount (Boundaries: "silently ensure one Chat Session exists").
51	    widget.cubit.init();
52	    _scrollController.addListener(_recordScrollOffset);
53	  }
54	
55	  @override
56	  void dispose() {
57	    _scrollController.removeListener(_recordScrollOffset);
58	    _textController.dispose();
59	    _scrollController.dispose();
60	    _composerFocusNode.dispose();
61	    super.dispose();
62	  }
63	
64	  /// Boundaries: "Scroll-offset restore is in-memory only, keyed by
65	  /// `sessionId`, on `ChatCubit`" — this is the one listener that keeps
66	  /// it current, firing on every scroll update while a session is active.
67	  void _recordScrollOffset() {
68	    final state = widget.cubit.state;
69	    if (state is ChatReady && _scrollController.hasClients) {
70	      widget.cubit.recordScrollOffset(
71	        state.sessionId,
72	        _scrollController.position.pixels,
73	      );
74	    }
75	  }
76	
77	  void _send() {
78	    final text = _textController.text;
79	    if (text.trim().isEmpty) {
80	      return;
81	    }
82	    widget.cubit.sendMessage(text);
83	    _textController.clear();
84	  }
85	
86	  /// Only jumps to the bottom when the view was already there (or close
87	  /// to it) *before* this update, or hasn't attached to a scrollable yet
88	  /// (the very first history render) — otherwise a user who deliberately
89	  /// scrolled up to reread earlier history would get yanked back down on
90	  /// every single streamed token.
91	  void _scrollToBottomSoon() {
92	    if (_scrollController.hasClients) {
93	      final position = _scrollController.position;
94	      const nearBottomThreshold = 80.0;
95	      final wasNearBottom =
96	          position.maxScrollExtent - position.pixels <= nearBottomThreshold;
97	      if (!wasNearBottom) {
98	        return;
99	      }
100	    }
101	    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
102	      if (_scrollController.hasClients) {
103	        _scrollController.jumpTo(_scrollController.position.maxScrollExtent);
104	      }
105	    });
106	  }
107	
108	  /// I/O matrix: "Switch session" — jumps to [offset] once the just-built
109	  /// history has attached to a scrollable, clamped to the actual
110	  /// `maxScrollExtent` in case the recorded offset no longer fits (a
111	  /// shorter history than when it was recorded).
112	  void _jumpToOffset(double offset) {
113	    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
114	      if (_scrollController.hasClients) {
115	        final maxExtent = _scrollController.position.maxScrollExtent;
116	        _scrollController.jumpTo(offset.clamp(0, maxExtent));
117	      }
118	    });
119	  }
120	
121	  /// Acceptance Criteria: "Given I tap 'Novo Chat' ... it opens empty,
122	  /// composer focused" — called whenever a session switch (new or past)
123	  /// lands on zero messages, per the listener's own `state.messages.
124	  /// isEmpty` guard below; a brand new session is always empty, so this
125	  /// satisfies the AC, but an empty *past* session switched back into
126	  /// would trigger it too (harmless — focusing the composer on an empty
127	  /// conversation is never wrong, just not the literal scenario the AC
128	  /// names).
129	  void _focusComposerSoon() {
130	    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
131	      if (mounted) {
132	        _composerFocusNode.requestFocus();
133	      }
134	    });
135	  }
136	
137	  @override
138	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
139	    return BlocProvider<ChatCubit>.value(
140	      value: widget.cubit,
141	      child: Scaffold(
142	        backgroundColor: DesignTokens.colorSurfaceBg,
143	        drawer: const AppDrawer(),
144	        // Boundaries: "heavier drawer scrim rgba(36,31,25,.4)" — overrides
145	        // `Scaffold`'s own default barrier, same convention the deleted
146	        // `HomeChatPlaceholderScreen` already used.
147	        drawerScrimColor: DesignTokens.colorScrimHeavy,
148	        body: Column(
149	          children: [
150	            const _ChatHeader(),
151	            // spec-6-3 — the offline banner, visible for the lifetime of
152	            // `ChatReady.isOffline`; renders nothing otherwise. Sits
153	            // between the header and the message list (Code Map) so
154	            // history stays fully visible/scrollable underneath it
155	            // (Boundaries).
156	            BlocBuilder<ChatCubit, ChatState>(
157	              builder: (context, state) => state is ChatReady && state.isOffline
158	                  ? const _OfflineBanner()
159	                  : const SizedBox.shrink(),
160	            ),
161	            Expanded(
162	              child: BlocConsumer<ChatCubit, ChatState>(
163	                listener: (context, state) {
164	                  if (state is! ChatReady) {
165	                    return;
166	                  }
167	                  final isNewSession = state.sessionId != _lastSessionId;
168	                  _lastSessionId = state.sessionId;
169	                  if (!isNewSession) {
170	                    _scrollToBottomSoon();
171	                    return;
172	                  }
173	                  final restoreScrollOffset = state.restoreScrollOffset;
174	                  if (restoreScrollOffset != null) {
175	                    _jumpToOffset(restoreScrollOffset);
176	                  } else {
177	                    _scrollToBottomSoon();
178	                  }
179	                  if (state.messages.isEmpty) {
180	                    _focusComposerSoon();
181	                  }
182	                },
183	                builder: (context, state) => switch (state) {
184	                  ChatBootstrapLoading() => const Center(
185	                    child: CircularProgressIndicator(
186	                      color: DesignTokens.colorPrimary,
187	                    ),
188	                  ),
189	                  ChatBootstrapError(failure: final failure) =>
190	                    _ChatBootstrapErrorView(failure: failure),
191	                  ChatReady(messages: final messages) => ListView.builder(
192	                    controller: _scrollController,
193	                    padding: DesignTokens.screenPadding,
194	                    itemCount: messages.length,
195	                    itemBuilder: (context, index) => ChatBubble(
196	                      key: ValueKey(messages[index].id),
197	                      message: messages[index],
198	                      // spec-6-3 — only a `failed` AI bubble ever renders
199	                      // the tap-to-retry copy at all (`ChatBubble`'s own
200	                      // guard), so wiring this unconditionally on every
201	                      // bubble is harmless.
202	                      onRetry: () =>
203	                          widget.cubit.retryMessage(messages[index].id),
204	                    ),
205	                  ),
206	                },
207	              ),
208	            ),
209	            _ChatComposer(
210	              controller: _textController,
211	              focusNode: _composerFocusNode,
212	              onSend: _send,
213	            ),
214	          ],
215	        ),
216	      ),
217	    );
218	  }
219	}

1	import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';
2	
3	part 'failure.freezed.dart';
4	
5	/// AD-3 — the one closed `Failure` hierarchy, exactly 14 subtypes: the 13
6	/// codes from `docs/input/backend/error-taxonomy.md` plus the local-only
7	/// `malformedResponse` (client-side parse failure, never sent by the
8	/// backend). Never redefined or subset per feature; every repository method
9	/// returns `Either<Failure, T>` built from this type (RNF09).
10	///
11	/// `retryable` is derived here, once, from the 6 server `retryable:true`
12	/// codes (AD-4) — no other file re-decides which codes retry.
13	@freezed
14	sealed class Failure with _$Failure {
15	  const factory Failure.authExpired({required String message}) = AuthExpired;
16	  const factory Failure.authInvalid({required String message}) = AuthInvalid;
17	  const factory Failure.networkTimeout({required String message}) =
18	      NetworkTimeout;
19	  const factory Failure.networkOffline({required String message}) =
20	      NetworkOffline;
21	  const factory Failure.validation({required String message}) = Validation;
22	  const factory Failure.piiCheckFailed({required String message}) =
23	      PiiCheckFailed;
24	  const factory Failure.embeddingFailed({required String message}) =
25	      EmbeddingFailed;
26	  const factory Failure.aiGenerationTimeout({required String message}) =
27	      AiGenerationTimeout;
28	  const factory Failure.notFound({required String message}) = NotFound;
29	  const factory Failure.rateLimited({required String message}) = RateLimited;
30	  const factory Failure.exportEmptyPeriod({required String message}) =
31	      ExportEmptyPeriod;
32	  const factory Failure.payloadTooLarge({required String message}) =
33	      PayloadTooLarge;
34	  const factory Failure.ocrNoText({required String message}) = OcrNoText;
35	
36	  /// Local-only — the client's own parse-failure detection. `retryable` is
37	  /// hardcoded `false` for this subtype (AD-3).
38	  const factory Failure.malformedResponse({required String message}) =
39	      MalformedResponse;
40	
41	  const Failure._();
42	
43	  /// The 6 server `retryable:true` codes (AD-4). Every other code —
44	  /// including the local `malformedResponse` — is `false`.
45	  bool get retryable => switch (this) {
46	        NetworkTimeout() => true,
47	        NetworkOffline() => true,
48	        PiiCheckFailed() => true,
49	        EmbeddingFailed() => true,
50	        AiGenerationTimeout() => true,
51	        RateLimited() => true,
52	        AuthExpired() ||
53	        AuthInvalid() ||
54	        Validation() ||
55	        NotFound() ||
56	        ExportEmptyPeriod() ||
57	        PayloadTooLarge() ||
58	        OcrNoText() ||
59	        MalformedResponse() =>
60	          false,
61	      };
62	
63	  /// Maps a backend error `code` (`error-taxonomy.md`) to its `Failure`
64	  /// subtype. An unrecognized code (should never happen — the taxonomy is
65	  /// closed) falls back to [Failure.malformedResponse] rather than throwing,
66	  /// so no repository ever lets an unmapped error escape (RNF09).
67	  factory Failure.fromCode(String code, String message) => switch (code) {
68	        'AUTH_EXPIRED' => Failure.authExpired(message: message),
69	        'AUTH_INVALID' => Failure.authInvalid(message: message),
70	        'NETWORK_TIMEOUT' => Failure.networkTimeout(message: message),
71	        'NETWORK_OFFLINE' => Failure.networkOffline(message: message),
72	        'VALIDATION_ERROR' => Failure.validation(message: message),
73	        'PII_CHECK_FAILED' => Failure.piiCheckFailed(message: message),
74	        'EMBEDDING_FAILED' => Failure.embeddingFailed(message: message),
75	        'AI_GENERATION_TIMEOUT' =>
76	          Failure.aiGenerationTimeout(message: message),
77	        'NOT_FOUND' => Failure.notFound(message: message),
78	        'RATE_LIMITED' => Failure.rateLimited(message: message),
79	        'EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD' => Failure.exportEmptyPeriod(message: message),
80	        'PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE' => Failure.payloadTooLarge(message: message),
81	        'OCR_NO_TEXT' => Failure.ocrNoText(message: message),
82	        _ => Failure.malformedResponse(message: message),
83	      };
84	}
85

1	/// `chat.messages.list`'s own `role` enum (`openapi.yaml:1188-1192`).
2	enum ChatMessageRole { user, assistant }
3	
4	/// `chat.messages.list`'s own `status` enum (`openapi.yaml:1198-1203`) —
5	/// the exact 3 states RF04's own Acceptance Criteria names
6	/// ("processing/streaming, error, complete"), reused verbatim here rather
7	/// than a second near-duplicate enum: [ChatMessageStatus.failed] is this
8	/// story's "error" state, [ChatMessageStatus.streaming] its
9	/// "processing/streaming" state.
10	enum ChatMessageStatus { streaming, complete, failed }
11	
12	/// A persisted chat message — `chat.messages.list`'s own response `data`
13	/// item (`openapi.yaml:1180-1218`), modeled 1:1. A plain value type, no
14	/// `freezed` (same rationale as [ChatSession]/`Entry`), but with a
15	/// `copyWith` — unlike those two, this entity's [content]/[status] mutate
16	/// repeatedly as a streaming response grows (`ChatCubit`'s own append-only
17	/// message list rebuilds entries of this exact shape on every `token`
18	/// event).
19	class ChatMessage {
20	  const ChatMessage({
21	    required this.id,
22	    required this.sessionId,
23	    required this.role,
24	    required this.content,
25	    required this.seq,
26	    required this.status,
27	    required this.retryCount,
28	    required this.createdAt,
29	  });
30	
31	  final String id;
32	  final String sessionId;
33	  final ChatMessageRole role;
34	  final String content;
35	  final int seq;
36	  final ChatMessageStatus status;
37	  final int retryCount;
38	  final String createdAt;
39	
40	  ChatMessage copyWith({String? content, ChatMessageStatus? status}) =>
41	      ChatMessage(
42	        id: id,
43	        sessionId: sessionId,
44	        role: role,
45	        content: content ?? this.content,
46	        seq: seq,
47	        status: status ?? this.status,
48	        retryCount: retryCount,
49	        createdAt: createdAt,
50	      );
51	
52	  @override
53	  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
54	      identical(this, other) ||
55	      (other is ChatMessage &&
56	          other.id == id &&
57	          other.sessionId == sessionId &&
58	          other.role == role &&
59	          other.content == content &&
60	          other.seq == seq &&
61	          other.status == status &&
62	          other.retryCount == retryCount &&
63	          other.createdAt == createdAt);
64	
65	  @override
66	  int get hashCode => Object.hash(
67	    id,
68	    sessionId,
69	    role,
70	    content,
71	    seq,
72	    status,
73	    retryCount,
74	    createdAt,
75	  );
76	
77	  @override
78	  String toString() =>
79	      'ChatMessage(id: $id, sessionId: $sessionId, role: $role, '
80	      'content: $content, seq: $seq, status: $status, '
81	      'retryCount: $retryCount, createdAt: $createdAt)';
82	}

352	/// [ChatBubble]'s own timestamp caption — `createdAt`'s local wall-clock
353	/// time, `HH:mm`, or "agora" for a message with no server timestamp yet
354	/// ([ChatUiMessage.createdAt]'s own doc) or one that fails to parse
355	/// (RNF09: never throws on a malformed value), same defensive shape
356	/// `entry_record_card.dart`'s own `_formatTime` already uses.
357	String _formatTime(String? createdAt) {
358	  if (createdAt == null) {
359	    return 'agora';
360	  }
361	  final local = DateTime.tryParse(createdAt)?.toLocal();
362	  if (local == null) {
363	    return 'agora';
364	  }
365	  final hour = local.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
366	  final minute = local.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
367	  return '$hour:$minute';
368	}

input.message:
Implemented story 6.4 (Bookmark a Chat Message into an Entry) exactly per `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-6-4-bookmark-a-chat-message-into-an-entry.md` (amended version, including the round-1 RF10-use-case fix). Followed the Suggested Review Order.

## Changes

**Core**
- `lib/core/isolated_side_effect.dart` — replaced the `UnimplementedError` stub with the real never-throws body: `try { return right(await action()); } catch (e) { return left(Failure.malformedResponse(message: e.toString())); }`.
- `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` — added `chatBookmarkIconSize` (16.0, standalone literal, not an alias of `entriesSearchBarIconSize`) and `chatBookmarkSavingLabelMaxWidth` (64.0, caps the Reduce-Motion "Salvando" label).

**Entries feature**
- `lib/features/entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart`, `data/repositories/entries_repository_impl.dart`, `data/datasources/entries_remote_data_source.dart` — added optional `chatMessageId` through all three layers; the data source sends it as `'chatMessageId': ?chatMessageId` in the `entries-create` body, mirroring the existing `mediaDurationSeconds` convention.
- `lib/features/entries/domain/usecases/save_chat_message_as_entry_use_case.dart` (new) — `SaveChatMessageAsEntryUseCase` (abstract, `call({content, chatMessageId})`) + `SaveChatMessageAsEntryUseCaseImpl`, forwarding to `EntriesRepository.create(..., source: EntrySource.chat, chatMessageId: ...)`. Pure domain, no `flutter`/`data` import.
- `lib/features/entries/entries_injection.dart` — registered `SaveChatMessageAsEntryUseCase` as a `lazySingleton` wrapping `sl<EntriesRepository>()`.

**Chat feature**
- `lib/features/chat/domain/entities/bookmark_state.dart` (new) — sealed `BookmarkState` with `idle()/saving()/saved()/error(Failure)` factories, mirrors `SyncBadgeState`'s shape.
- `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_state.dart` — `ChatUiMessage.bookmarkState` (default `.idle()`), threaded through `copyWith`/`==`/`hashCode`/`toString`.
- `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_cubit.dart` — `ChatCubit` now takes a 3rd ctor param, `SaveChatMessageAsEntryUseCase` (importing only the use-case file, never `entries/domain/repositories/`). Added `bookmarkMessage(messageId)`: guards (not `ChatReady`, not found, not a user message, `serverId == null`, already `saved`/`saving`) → emits `.saving()` (guarded by `isClosed`) → calls `isolatedSideEffect(() => _saveChatMessageAsEntry(...))` → flattens the outer (thrown-exception) and inner (normal save failure) `Either`s into one → emits `.saved()`/`.error(failure)` on the freshest state (guarded by `isClosed` again).
- `lib/features/chat/chat_injection.dart` — wired `sl<SaveChatMessageAsEntryUseCase>()` as the 3rd `ChatCubit` arg (registered by `registerEntriesFeature()`, which always runs first).
- `lib/features/chat/presentation/widgets/chat_bubble.dart` — added `onBookmark: ValueChanged<String>?`; a bookmark button (44×44pt tap target, `Semantics(button: true)` only when `onBookmark` is set) rendered beside the timestamp caption, user bubbles only. Icon+color per state: idle outline/`colorTextSecondary`, saving spinner (or width-capped "Salvando" label under Reduce Motion), saved check/`colorAccent`, error warning/`colorError`.
- `lib/features/chat/presentation/screens/chat_screen.dart` — wired `onBookmark: (id) => cubit.bookmarkMessage(id)`.

## Tests (all new/extended per the Code Map)
- `test/core/isolated_side_effect_test.dart` (new) — success passthrough, sync/async throw → `malformedResponse`, message/retryable assertions.
- `test/features/entries/domain/usecases/save_chat_message_as_entry_use_case_test.dart` (new) — forwards verbatim with `source: EntrySource.chat`; passes `Right`/`Left` through unmapped.
- `test/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl_test.dart`, `.../data/datasources/entries_remote_data_source_test.dart` — extended for `chatMessageId` passthrough.
- `test/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_cubit_test.dart` — new `bookmarkMessage()` group covering the full I/O matrix (happy path, already-saved no-op, no-serverId no-op, AI-bubble no-op, save-fails→error, side-effect-throws→malformedResponse, second-tap-while-saving no-op, failure isolation, close()-while-in-flight) via a new controllable `_FakeSaveChatMessageAsEntryUseCase`.
- `test/features/chat/presentation/widgets/chat_bubble_test.dart` — new group covering per-state icon/color, Reduce-Motion label + its width cap, tap wiring/Semantics/44pt target, AI-bubble exclusion.
- `test/features/chat/presentation/screens/chat_screen_test.dart` — new end-to-end test tapping the bookmark icon on a real pumped `ChatScreen`, asserting the wired-through fake use case was called with the right `content`/`chatMessageId`.
- `test/main_test.dart` — swapped `ChatCubit`'s 3rd arg for a throwing `_UnusedSaveChatMessageAsEntryUseCase`, matching the "never expected to be called" convention.
- `test/features/entries/domain/services/pending_entry_write_tracker_test.dart` — added `chatMessageId` to its `_FakeEntriesRepository.create()` override at the correct 4-space indent (the exact nit the spec called out).

**Incidental but necessary fixes** (not named in the spec's Code Map, but required for `flutter analyze`'s zero-issues gate since `EntriesRepository.create()`'s new optional param is a required part of every valid override): added `String? chatMessageId` to every other test fake implementing `EntriesRepository` directly — `test/core/navigation/app_router_test.dart`, `.../presentation/cubit/entries_search_cubit_test.dart`, `.../presentation/cubit/entry_detail_cubit_test.dart`, `.../presentation/cubit/meus_registros_cubit_test.dart`, `.../presentation/screens/entry_detail_screen_test.dart`, `.../presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen_test.dart`, `.../presentation/widgets/entries_filter_sheet_test.dart` — and added a 3rd `ChatCubit` constructor arg everywhere else it's instantiated directly: `test/core/navigation/app_router_test.dart`, `test/core/widgets/app_drawer_test.dart` (throwing fakes in both, since neither suite exercises bookmarking).

## Verification
- `fvm flutter pub get` — resolves, no conflicts.
- `fvm flutter analyze` — **0 issues**.
- `fvm flutter test` — **999 tests, all passed**.
- `fvm dart format` applied only to the files this story created/touched (the pre-existing repo already has ~70 files that disagree with this Dart SDK's formatter — a pre-existing drift unrelated to this story; I left those untouched rather than reformatting the whole repo as a side effect).
- `registerChatFeature()` runs after `registerEntriesFeature()` in `injection_container.dart`, so `sl<SaveChatMessageAsEntryUseCase>()` is always registered before `ChatCubit` resolves it; `test/features/chat/chat_flow_e2e_test.dart` and `test/core/di/bootstrap_integration_test.dart` (both resolve `sl<ChatCubit>()` through the real DI graph) needed no changes and still pass.

## Boundary verification
Grepped `lib/features/chat/` and confirmed `ChatCubit`/`chat_injection.dart` only ever import `entries/domain/entities/entry.dart` and `entries/domain/usecases/save_chat_message_as_entry_use_case.dart` — never `EntriesRepository`, `entries/data/`, or `entries/presentation/` (every other hit is a doc comment, not an import).

## Nothing left incomplete
All Code Map items, Tasks & Acceptance checkboxes, and the I/O & Edge-Case Matrix are covered by tests. No risks identified — the one judgment call worth flagging is the "second emit after switchSession mid-save" edge case: if a session switch happens while a bookmark save is in flight, the second `emit()` rebuilds `latest.messages` with a no-op `for...if` (the `messageId` simply won't match anything in the new session's list), which is safe but wasn't explicitly covered by a dedicated test since it's outside this story's own I/O matrix.
